entities.summary: Black January and Independence Movement, a transformative movement in Azerbaijan (1988–1991). Emerged from Azerbaijan declares independence from the Soviet Union and Aliyev Era and National Consciousness. Catalyzed Black January — Soviet troops kill over 130 civilians in Baku and First Karabakh War and Displacement.
